claims.source_quote_ar: هُوَ فِي مَوْضِعِ رَفْعٍ، وَ «الْحَقُّ» : خَبَرُهُ.
claims.claim_ar: يجوز أن يكون «الَّذِي» في موضع رفعٍ وخبره «الْحَقُّ» (أي: «الَّذِي» مبتدأ مرفوع وخبره «الْحَقُّ»).
claims.claim_en: "al-laḏī" may be in the nominative (raised) position with "al-ḥaqq" as its predicate (i.e., "al-laḏī" functioning as a مبتدأ and "al-ḥaqq" as its خبر).
claims.needs_review_reason: Explicitly stated in the source as one of two possible analyses; applicability depends on presence of the predicate in the larger context.

claims.claim_ar: وجهٌ آخر أن تكون «الَّذِي» صِفَةً (نعتًا) لاسمٍ سابقٍ (أي: «الَّذِي» نعت/صفة للاسم المعني).
claims.claim_en: An alternative analysis is that "al-laḏī" is an adjectival modifier (ṣifah / naʿt) of a preceding noun (i.e., "al-laḏī" as an attributive adjective).
claims.needs_review_reason: Explicit alternative given in the source; its validity depends on the antecedent in context (i.e., whether there is an appropriate noun to which it attaches).

claims.claim_ar: المصدر يذكر قاعدة أن الواو قد تُدخَلُ في الصفة (أُدخِلَتِ الْوَاوُ فِي الصِّفَةِ)، كحالة نحوية تُؤثر في بنية الصفة.
claims.claim_en: The source notes a grammatical rule that a waw can be inserted into an adjectival construction (i.e., insertion of the conjunctional waw into a ṣifah), which affects the syntactic construction.
claims.needs_review_reason: Statement in the source is descriptive of a syntactic phenomenon; applying it to this specific occurrence requires confirming that the construction involves such an inserted waw in the verse's immediate context.
